call.speaker: SALIM
call.text: Control, booth three. Sir, a white Omni just went through. Bombay plate.

pillai.speaker: PILLAI (RADIO)
pillai.text: Omni? I've had your lane camera up the whole time, Salim. Nothing has gone through booth three in an hour.

choices.text: It paid, sir. I have the money in the tray.

count.speaker: PILLAI (RADIO)
count.text: Then count it again. And stop calling me about ghosts.

wash.speaker: PILLAI (RADIO)
wash.text: Then go wash your face. Two more hours.
